observations.description: Barcelona circulate the ball in front of the compact Bayern defensive block.
Messi receives on the right and advances towards Boateng.
Messi changes direction past Boateng, who loses his footing.
Messi lifts a right-footed chip over Neuer.
The ball crosses the line; Barcelona celebrate.
A slow-motion replay shows the change of direction and right-footed chip.

lines.text: Barcelona keep working the ball, looking for a way through.
Bayern are narrow. Messi has room on this side.
Here is Messi, taking on Boateng...
And over Neuer! Messi, that is absolutely magnificent!
He makes Boateng commit, then shifts onto his right foot. Neuer comes out, and Messi just lifts it over him.
He makes it look so simple, doesn't he?
That's balance and composure. The defender goes down; Messi stays in complete control.
